Died during a meteor impact hundreds of years ago. |affiliation = Ostina |spouse = Aeschylus |spouseNote = deceased |voiceEN = |voiceCN = |voiceJP = |voiceKR = }} '''Leah''' {{Lang|zh=丽亚}} is a quest-exclusive [[NPC]] that first appears in {{Quest|Dreamcatchers in the Secret Gardens}}. After completing Dreamcatchers in the Secret Gardens her reverberation can be found in the [[Lost Beyond]]. ==Quests and Events== {{Quests and Events}} ==Dialogue== {{Dialogue Start}} ;(After 18:00) :;'''Aeschylus''' So what do you think? :;'''Leah''' Yawn... :'''Aeschylus:''' Don't be indifferent. Now listen, a normal welcome-back party is boring. We should throw a surprise party. The youths do like surprises. :'''Leah:''' There's a fine line between surprise and jump scare. :'''Aeschylus:''' Hehe, she's brave than you. Maybe she's into that kind of thing. :{{DIcon}} What are you talking about? :'''Aeschylus:''' Oh, it's you. Phrolova is out performing, and we're discussing how to organize a party for her return. :'''Leah:''' You act younger than the youths of today. Try not to overexert yourself. Oh, you seem tired, child. Care for a glass of water? :'''Aeschylus:''' Hey child, do you like my idea? If we throw a surprise party, maybe they'll let me be the main organizer. :{{DIcon}} It's a good idea. ::'''Aeschylus:''' Hahaha, I most certainly know what the youths want. What have you got to say to that, Leah? ::'''Leah:''' Sigh... :{{DIcon}} Why do you care so much? ::'''Aeschylus:''' Uh... haha, we saw them grow up. Those young'uns are like family to us. ::'''Aeschylus:''' Besides, I need to be important to them. If they enjoy my company, they won't forget to visit us from time to time. ::'''Aeschylus:''' Unlike our own ungrateful brat... He never... ::'''Leah:''' Okay, that's enough. {{Dialogue End}} ==Gallery== {{Files by Character Gallery}} ===Videos=== Wuthering Waves Story Cinematics - Fading Notes ==Other Languages == {{Other Languages |en = Leah |zhs = 丽亚 |zht = 麗亞 |ja = リーア |ko = 리아 |fr = Leah |de = Leah |es = Leah |th = ลีอา }} ==Change History== {{Change History|2.5}}
